description: MUDBASE is a scalable, real-time, and secure Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform  designed for modern applications. Built with custom logic, it offers fine-grained  control, extensibility, and enterprise-grade security.  ## Features - 🔐 Multi-provider authentication (30+ OAuth providers) - 📊 Real-time database with collections - 📁 File storage and management - 🔑 API key management with permissions - 🔗 Webhook system with retry logic - ⚡ Serverless functions - 💬 Multi-channel messaging (Push, Email, SMS) - 📈 Usage analytics and monitoring - 🌐 Real-time WebSocket events - 🔍 Full-text search capabilities - 💳 Billing: fiat only for project subscriptions and org BaaS checkout (platform fee split). On-chain billing is not exposed on these APIs (optional `crypto-payment-module/` in repo, not mounted by default). - 🏢 Enterprise / Phase 4: custom domains on Growth, Scale, and Enterprise (TXT DNS at `_mudbase-verify.<hostname>`); `settings.customDomainAddon` is optional (billing/legacy); dedicated DB migration script, periodic DNS recheck job, optional `infrastructureEnvironments[]` and edge/metering fields on `dedicated`.
